reference.server: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Debian 18.4-1.pgdg13+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
reference.method: Independent PostgreSQL queries and psql gdesc in Docker; temporary table only.

setup: CREATE TABLE source_input(id integer, label text)

cases.sql: SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT id, label FROM source_input OFFSET 0) AS inner_input OFFSET 0) AS outer_input ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM source_input WHERE false OFFSET 0) AS empty_input
SELECT value FROM (SELECT id + 1 AS value FROM source_input OFFSET 0) AS derived WHERE value > 2 ORDER BY value
SELECT id, n FROM (SELECT id, count(*) AS n FROM source_input GROUP BY id OFFSET 0) AS grouped ORDER BY id
SELECT id, value FROM source_input, LATERAL (SELECT value FROM (SELECT source_input.id + 1 AS value OFFSET 0) AS nested_input OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY id
WITH input AS (SELECT 7 AS value) SELECT value FROM (SELECT value FROM (SELECT * FROM input OFFSET 0) AS nested_input OFFSET 0) AS derived
WITH input AS (SELECT 'outer'::text AS value) SELECT value FROM (WITH input AS (SELECT 7 AS value) SELECT * FROM input OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT value FROM (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1, 2) AS series(value) OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY value
SELECT value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id AS value FROM source_input ORDER BY value LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS derived
SELECT a, b FROM (SELECT id AS a FROM source_input OFFSET 0) AS left_input CROSS JOIN (SELECT id AS b FROM source_input OFFSET 0) AS right_input ORDER BY a, b
SELECT value, value FROM (SELECT id AS value FROM source_input OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM missing_first, missing_second) AS derived
SELECT missing_outer FROM (SELECT missing_inner FROM source_input) AS derived
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM source_input WHERE missing_where > 0) AS derived ORDER BY missing_order
